integrity: The argument is a self-contained Rayleigh/Foster proof with a separately replayable exact spanning-tree enumerator. All calculations are finite corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only finite connected simple graphs with unit electrical resistances; exact equality for simplicial vertices, not all graphs. Historical priority provisional; no claim of nonchordal classification.
title: Sharp simplicial Foster-curvature bounds, equality classification, and chordal rigidity
